items.title: Encore3 toolset v10.0.2
items.brief: Barco's Encore3 update targets stability and field-reported issues; no new features listed.
items.what: Barco released Encore3 toolset v10.0.2, which it says addresses several field-reported issues and improves system stability. The page lists ultrawide DisplayPort input, I/O and AUX output enhancements, and linking workflow improvements as upcoming priorities, and says development has begun on input/output expansion and AVoIP integration.
items.why: It shows where the Encore3 roadmap is headed for rental and touring users. The page lists no new features in this release itself.
items.watch: Full Encore3 compatibility for the EC-210 controller, which Barco says is in progress with a goal of completing before the end of the year.

items.title: COEX K-POP Square 12K LED on Aquilon C+
items.brief: Two Aquilon C+ (main/backup) drive a 12,060×3,015 Unilumin wall in Seoul.
items.spec: 81.4 × 20.1 m, 6.67 mm pitch, 12,000 nits, 15,360 Hz, 2,156 cabinets; Aquilon C+ up to 24× 4K60 in / 20× 4K60 out each
items.what: Kinoton replaced the 10 mm display at COEX K-POP Square for CJ CGV with a Unilumin Usurface III 6 Pro wall of about 1,616 m², processed by two Aquilon C+ units in a main/backup pair. The team preconfigured it with the Web RCS Emulator and had about three weeks to deliver.
items.why: It shows an Aquilon C+ pair driving a 12K-wide canvas with a full hot spare, and offline configuration in the emulator cutting on-site time.

items.title: CorePlay Tetra quad-output media playback engine
items.brief: 2RU media playback engine with four DisplayPort 1.4a outputs, up to 4096×2160 at 60 Hz.
items.spec: 4× DP 1.4a, 4096×2160 60 Hz 10-bit 4:4:4; up to 16 Players; H.264/H.265, ProRes 4444, HAP, AWX, DPX; 2 TB NVMe; 32-ch Dante; 2× LTC; 10 GbE
items.what: Analog Way launched CorePlay Tetra, a 2RU playback engine with four independently configured DisplayPort 1.4a outputs and an NVIDIA RTX 4000 Blackwell GPU. Control is through CorePlay RCS, a REST CoreAPI, Bitfocus Companion and native Stream Deck. No price is stated.
items.why: Analog Way positions it between media players and flagship media servers, feeding hero video, backgrounds and LED content directly to Aquilon inputs for productions that don't need a full media server.
items.watch: Factory options (genlock, 12G-SDI and HDMI 2.0 inputs, extra 10 GbE) are listed without dates.

items.title: University of Konstanz powerwall on Aquilon C+
items.brief: Aquilon C+ drives the powerwall at Germany's University of Konstanz.
items.what: Analog Way published a customer story on an Aquilon C+ driving the powerwall at the University of Konstanz in Germany.

items.title: Aquilon firmware 6.2
items.brief: Native stereoscopic 3D and Backup Groups that switch several backups with one action.
items.spec: 3D up to UHD 60 Hz per eye; 3840×2160 at 120 Hz 4:4:4 8-bit via DP cards; canvases up to 8 UHD or 16 HD/DL outputs
items.what: Aquilon 6.2 adds native frame-sequential 3D on the DisplayPort 1.2/1.4 cards, mixed 2D/3D compositions and glasses sync control. Backup Groups let input and background backups switch together, manually or automatically when a member fails, in Web RCS and on a custom key of the RC400T. It also adds 8K30 and ultra-wide predefined formats and VESA CVT-R2 reduced blanking for custom formats.
items.why: Grouped failover shortens recovery on a main/backup show. The page does not list supported Aquilon models.

items.title: P80 switcher and U5 Mini control surface
items.brief: P80 4K presentation switcher sits between the P Series and Q8; U5 Mini is a compact controller.
items.spec: P80: 16 fixed + 6 switchable-format inputs, up to 8 screen systems (Main + Flex), LINK, genlock, SDI matrix, 10G optical. U5 Mini: 66 buttons, two 7-in LCDs, T-Bar or Fader
items.what: PLSN covers PixelHue's P80, a 4K presentation switcher aimed at medium-to-large productions, and the U5 Mini, a compact control surface introduced in 2026. LINK shares 4K sources across multiple P80 units. The U5 Mini is programmed in PixelFlow and has built-in Companion compatibility.
items.why: P80 fills the gap between the compact P Series and the flagship Q8, and LINK allows multi-unit 4K source sharing.
items.watch: The article gives no price or ship date.

items.title: Firmware 1.6.2 for P20 and Q8
items.brief: New P20 layer mode, Q8 3D glasses output, Dante audio matrix and backup-of-backup control.
items.spec: P20: 4 Main + 4 PIP layers (or 2 Main + 10 PIP); Dante matrix 64×64 on Q8, 32×32 on P20 DS
items.what: Firmware 1.6.2 adds a 4 Main + 4 PIP layer mode on the P20, 3D transmission to glasses on the Q8, input backup management including a backup of the backup, output connection grouping, optimized preset loading, and Dante with a new Audio Matrix on the Q8 and P20 DS.
items.why: It is the most recent P20/Q8 firmware release found; check PixelHue's downloads for anything newer.
